missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend vitamin E until dose, medication list, bleeding history and procedure timing are reviewed by a clinician/pharmacist.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume dietary vitamin E has the same risk profile as high-dose supplements.
Do not advise stopping anticoagulants or antiplatelet medicines.
Do not recommend high-dose vitamin E for general prevention.
professional_escalation_conditions: Active bleeding, anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, bleeding disorder, planned surgery or prior hemorrhagic stroke.
population_and_context: People with bleeding disorders, taking antithrombotic medicines or approaching surgery who are considering vitamin E supplements; high supplemental doses may affect hemostasis.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Assess supplemental alpha-tocopherol amount and all medicines; perioperative decisions belong to treating clinician.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin E fact sheet describes bleeding concerns at high supplemental doses and medication interactions; risk depends on dose and context.
